name: assign-stmt-test-4075ad6286/assign-stmt-semantics-negative-e.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: Destructuring assignment statement — Only supports `wildcard-binding-pattern`
reason: The case asserts diagnostics for list and error destructuring assignments using type-name targets. These require non-wildcard binding patterns, whereas subset 10 supports only wildcard destructuring. This essential unsupported construct makes the whole case a feature case even though ordinary assignment rejection is in scope.
unsupported_constructs: List destructuring assignments, including nested and rest patterns: [Foo, a], [[Foo], a], [...Foo]
Error destructuring assignments: error(Foo), error(b, Foo)
test_design_notes: Negative compile-time test with @error assertions; no @args, @panic, or @output execution protocol.
